subject: ENGLISH
title: Sentence Workshop
objective: Distinguish complete sentences from fragments and use capitals and end punctuation.
introduction: A complete sentence expresses a complete thought and normally has a subject and predicate. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: Marks like . ! ? that help us read clearly.
A group of words that tells a complete idea.
The part of a sentence that tells who or what.
